title: Cost controls by decision point

categories.label: Avoid the agent
categories.principle: Use deterministic logic first and do not start inference when no reasoning is needed.

controls.name: Search-based skip filters
controls.syntax:
on:
  issues:
    types: [opened]
  skip-if-match: 'label:duplicate OR label:wont-fix'
  skip-if-no-match: 'label:needs-triage'
controls.effect: Runs in pre-activation and skips the agent job before inference.

controls.name: Deterministic steps and noop
controls.syntax:
steps:
  - name: Skip empty backlog
    run: |
      count=$(gh issue list --state open --json number --jq length)
      if [ "$count" -eq 0 ]; then
        echo '{"type":"noop","message":"No work"}' >> "$GH_AW_SAFE_OUTPUTS"
      fi
controls.effect: Performs deterministic preprocessing and can stop the engine without AI Credits when scripting is required.

controls.name: Schedules and batching
controls.syntax:
on:
  schedule: daily on weekdays
  workflow_dispatch:
controls.effect: Replaces one-run-per-event patterns with predictable, batchable invocation volume.

categories.label: Bound each run
categories.principle: Cap inference, turns, elapsed time, tools, and security analysis independently.

controls.name: Per-run AI Credits
controls.effect: Sets a hard AI Credits budget for one workflow run.

controls.name: Rolling daily AI Credits
controls.effect: Blocks new eligible runs after the workflow reaches the explicitly configured rolling 24-hour budget.

controls.name: Turn limit
controls.effect: Caps model/tool interaction turns for engines that honor the compiled control.

controls.name: Agent job timeout
controls.effect: Bounds wall-clock time for the agent job.

controls.name: Tool operation timeout
controls.effect: Bounds individual tool/MCP operations and MCP startup where supported by the engine.

controls.name: Threat-detection budget
controls.effect: Caps the independent threat-detection inference run. Current documentation explicitly states a 400 AIC fallback when unset.

categories.label: Bound repetition
categories.principle: Control retries, continuations, user invocation rate, and workflow lifetime.

controls.name: Harness retries
controls.syntax:
engine:
  id: copilot
  harness:
    max-retries: 1
    initial-delay-ms: 5000
    backoff-multiplier: 2
    max-delay-ms: 30000
controls.effect: Bounds retry attempts and backoff after engine failures; set explicitly when the documented engine defaults do not fit the workload.

controls.name: Copilot continuations
controls.effect: Bounds Copilot autopilot continuations when that mode is used.

controls.name: Per-user trigger rate
controls.syntax:
user-rate-limit:
  max-runs-per-window: 3
  window: 60
  events: [workflow_dispatch, issue_comment]
  ignored-roles: []
controls.effect: Limits how often one actor can start selected event types; it does not replace concurrency serialization.

controls.name: Workflow expiry
controls.effect: Prevents execution after an absolute or relative deadline.

categories.label: Right-size
categories.principle: Use the least costly model and smallest context that can reliably satisfy the task.

controls.name: Model selection
controls.effect: Routes structured, routine work to an appropriately capable model; available models and prices vary, so validate with current provider data.

categories.label: Measure value
categories.principle: Optimize cost against externally observable outcomes, not token reduction alone.

controls.name: Run logs
controls.effect: Reports run and episode duration, tokens, turns, AI Credits, lineage, and anomalies.

controls.name: Run audit
controls.effect: Supports a detailed review of token use, tool calls, performance, and inference spend for one run.

controls.name: OpenTelemetry
controls.effect: Exports traces and model/token metadata for cross-repository dashboards, alerting, and analysis.

controls.name: Repository-observed outcomes
controls.effect: Relates spend to later visible repository state such as merged pull requests or completed issues.

defaultPolicy: Values in examples are representative, not recommended universal defaults. Set budgets from workload evidence and current documentation, then review provider billing and repository outcomes.
